policy: Named fascia and the broader fascial system are separate display categories. Explicit owner decision: display existing iliotibial tracts and wrist flexor retinacula under Fascial system. Do not rename these meshes as whole fasciae.

fascialSystemParts.name: Right iliotibial tract
fascialSystemParts.notes: Included only in the broader Fascial system display category. This mesh does not represent the complete fascia lata. Subclassification is not established by the inspected tables.
